observations: Photo 0: black DSLR body labeled 'Canon' on front and 'EOS 650D' on top right, with a Canon-branded zoom lens (18-55mm markings visible) and front lens cap on, held in a hand.
Photo 1: rear of the same camera, LCD screen is folded/closed against the body so the screen itself is not visible or lit, control buttons (MENU, INFO, WB, SET, AF) visible and look intact.
Photo 2: top view showing mode dial (M, Av, Tv, P, Auto, Video), ON/OFF switch, ISO button, hot-shoe, and the lens barrel marked 'Canon' with focal length scale 18-24-35-55.
No photo shows the camera powered on, no screen display, no battery, no memory card, and no shutter/actuation count.
Exterior plastic and lens barrel appear clean with no visible scratches, dents or fungus in the photos given.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 2 show a cosmetically clean body and lens, but 'UK Used' provenance and internal cleanliness (sensor, mirror) cannot be confirmed from photos.
No photo shows the camera powered on, the rear LCD lit, or a test shot; screen is folded closed in photo 1.

risks.risk: LCD screen may be faulty (cracked, dead pixels, hinge damage) since it is shown closed/folded in every photo.
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the screen open and powered on showing a live image or menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if screen is non-functional

risks.risk: Shutter actuation count unknown; could be heavily used despite cosmetic cleanliness.
risks.proof: A screenshot from shutter-count software (e.g. EOSInfo) or the in-camera menu shutter count display.

risks.risk: Lens autofocus, zoom ring, and image stabilizer functionality not demonstrated (lens cap on in all shots).
risks.proof: A video of the lens focusing and zooming smoothly on the camera body.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens not confirmed working

risks.risk: No battery, charger, or memory card shown; these affect usability and completeness of the kit.
risks.proof: A photo of the included battery, charger, and card (if any) laid out with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, accessories not included

risks.risk: Sensor dust, fungus, or internal fault not visible from exterior photos.
risks.proof: A photo taken through the lens at a bright blank surface (e.g. sky) at small aperture to reveal sensor spots.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unconfirmed, worst case assumed

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, LCD screen open and displaying a live view or menu.
Shutter count screenshot from diagnostic software or camera menu.
Video showing lens autofocus and zoom in action while mounted.
Photo of battery, charger, and memory card included in the sale.
A test photo taken with the camera and lens to confirm image quality and sensor condition.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS 650D with 18-55mm kit lens from the photos, but no functional claim (power-on, screen, shutter count, lens operation) is demonstrated, so it must be priced at worst case against comparable Canon/Nikon DSLR kits of similar class.
